_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Porter's Value Chain analysis for organizations, business units, products, services, platforms, operating models, and…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "Map our value chain and show where we create customer value, incur cost, and may have differentiation opportunities."
cases.context: The agent has access to the value-chain-analysis skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is value-chain-analysis the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes value-chain-analysis as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against playing-to-win, seven-powers, blue-ocean-strategy
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the value-chain-analysis workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore value-chain-analysis
Does not route to playing-to-win, seven-powers, blue-ocean-strategy when the value-chain-analysis scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
